description: Free-text search in active job listings in Norway on Kollegia, e.g. 'kokk i Bergen', 'deltidsjobb Trondheim', 'sykepleier Tromsø'. Place names and words like heltid/deltid/sommerjobb in the query are used as filters. Returns id, title and url per job; use fetch with the id for the full ad. (search_jobs offers the same with explicit filters.)
